newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Yizheng obtains $400 mln loans.
newsitem.headline: China's Yizheng obtains $400 mln loans.

text.p: The Jiangsu branch of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China has agreed to increase by 60 percent the ceiling on foreign exchange working capital loans for Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd this year, the Financial News said on Monday.

Qian Zhihong, president of the bank's branch in eastern Jiangsu province, and Ma Yiping, president of Yizheng, signed an agreement on March 12, in which the bank pledged to extend up to $400 million in foreign exchange working capital loans to Yizheng in 1997, the newspaper said.
That compared with $250 million last year, it said.
The loans would be used to import raw materials, it said, adding that each loan would mature within a year.
Yizheng's outstanding loans from the bank should not exceed $110 million by the end of the year, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
